tool_args.rationale: The proposed barrier-modulated siphon was decisively refuted on fresh confirmation. The source archive leaves an open branch sign in competing siphon mechanisms; a branch-discriminating probe is the most targeted next measurement before selecting a stationary model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Targets trajectory and ODE identifiability; the observed setup is a fixed-horizon transformed siphon, and the immediate failure calls for discriminating the open branch.
Irrelevant high-variance auxiliary measurements do not resolve the mechanism or branch ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Revise the barrier-modulated siphon fit without new data
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation RMSE 2.803225 far exceeds 0.045, so refitting the same mechanism without a discriminating observation is not justified.
